headline: Harbour Lights, starring Jack Dunmore, gets a 12 December cinema release
body: The Sydney-set thriller Harbour Lights will open in Australian cinemas on 12 December, its distributor has confirmed. Jack Dunmore leads the cast as a ferry captain who uncovers a smuggling ring during the final night of a harbour festival. The film was shot over eleven weeks on location around Circular Quay and the northern beaches, and a first trailer is due next week. Early festival audiences described it as a tense, atmospheric crime story told almost entirely after dark. The film runs 118 minutes. (Note: fictional sample story used for testing.)
